raw_segments.text: If, by the general progress of improvement, the demand of this market should increase,
while at the same time, the supply did not increase in the same proportion, the value
of silver would gradually rise in proportion to that of corn.
Any given quantity of silver would exchange for a greater and a greater quantity of corn.
Or, in other words, the average money price of corn would gradually become cheaper and
